features: Open project previews in a separate browser page or desktop window to browse files, preview Markdown, and inspect Git history and changes, with project switching and return to the preview after sign-in.
Search project filenames, paths, and file contents with scope, case-sensitive, whole-word, and regular-expression options, highlighted matches, and navigation to matching lines.
Register folders as deliverables and open them in project preview; existing file deliverables remain compatible.
Add a Todo plugin that displays live task progress above the composer, including nested tasks, parallel work, and blocked states.
Reload a work session's chat data from its context menu without restarting the session.
added: Support Devin quota queries through CPA, showing enabled accounts' daily and weekly remaining percentages, reset times, and plan names.
Support plugin widgets above and below the composer, responsive session-header actions and custom items, and SDK popovers.
changed: Removing models now cleans up associated presets and offers confirmation before replacing or clearing affected project defaults, including when editing native configuration.
Improve Markdown presentation with task-status indicators and alert blocks, plus syntax highlighting for language-tagged code blocks in plugin Markdown.
Plugin changes no longer automatically re-render existing chat history.
fixed: Improve chat scroll-position restoration and bottom-following when switching sessions or resizing the view.
Prevent long Markdown text from overflowing the chat view.
Automatically retry timed-out plugin loads once after the original setup and cleanup have finished.
Treat oversized streaming tool arguments as retryable failures without executing tools from the affected response, and wait for session cancellation to complete.
Wait for managed process groups to stop on Unix-like systems, and preserve more diagnostic details when Windows process cleanup fails.
